NEW DELHI: Several Aam Aadmi Party leaders including Saurabh Bharadwaj and MLA Jarnail Singh were detained outside the Delhi Police headquarters during a protest on Tuesday, demanding an FIR against Delhi minister Parvesh Varma for slapping a person during a road inspection in West Delhi’s Tilak Nagar.An FIR has also been registered against Bharadwaj, Jarnail Singh and other for allegedly assaulting a head constable during the protest."An FIR has been registered regarding the assault on a Delhi Police head constable. The FIR mentions the names of Saurabh Bharadwaj, Jarnail Singh, and AAP workers. An FIR has also been registered against Sahib Singh. Arvind Kejriwal had visited Tilak Nagar yesterday," Delhi Police said."The Delhi Police head constable was recording a video while in plain clothes. A crowd of AAP supporters surrounded and assaulted him. Subsequently, the Head Constable underwent a medical examination. A case has been registered under sections related to obstructing a public servant in the discharge of official duties and assaulting a public servant," it added.The complaint comes amid a political row over an alleged slapping incident involving Verma during a road inspection in Tilak Nagar on September 27.A purported video of the incident was shared by AAP leaders, showing Verma allegedly slapping Singh during a confrontation over the quality of a newly constructed road.Speaking to ANI before his detention during an AAP protest outside Vikaspuri police station, Bharadwaj alleged that Verma attacked the cameraman after AAP MLA Jarnail Singh demonstrated the poor quality of the road."When Jarnail Singh—in the presence of minister Parvesh Verma and the camera—demonstrated the poor quality of the road by breaking off a piece with his hands to expose the corruption and embezzlement of funds in road construction, Parvesh Verma flew into a rage. He attacked the cameraman, snatched his phone, slapped him, and attempted to destroy the evidence of corruption; when the young man lunged back towards him, he fled in fear and hid behind the police," Bharadwaj had said.Meanwhile, Sahib Singh, who alleged that Verma slapped him during the road inspection, claimed that the minister snatched his phone, twisted his arm and assaulted him after the condition of the road was highlighted. Singh also alleged that the police accepted his complaint but did not register an FIR against Verma.
Article Summary: Several Aam Aadmi Party leaders were detained outside the Delhi Police headquarters. They were demanding an FIR against Delhi minister Parvesh Varma for slapping a person. An FIR has also been registered against Bharadwaj, Jarnail Singh and other for allegedly assaulting a head constable during the protest.

Article Title: 'Full disclosure of electoral roll changes': Congress's 5 demands amid EC SIR row
Article Text:
Congress attacks EC over SIR row, says will fight ‘to save’ voters’ rights (Image source: X)

Kharge backs Rahul Gandhi’s voter-roll allegations

Congress lists five demands

Full data on major changes to voter lists should be made public.

Voters whose names have been removed should receive complete information and a full opportunity to appeal.

Political parties should receive voter lists and essential related data in a simple format and in a timely manner.

Serious discrepancies should be independently investigated within a fixed timeframe.

Election-related data and decisions should be transparent so that no political party can claim information is being withheld.

“The most important thing is that India's voters must have the confidence that their vote is secure,” Kharge said.

Kharge targets PM Modi, Shah and Election Commission

NEW DELHI: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge on Tuesday accused the Election Commission of compromising the integrity of the electoral process through the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of voter rolls and changes to voter-enrolment rules. He also stated that the party would step up its campaign against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the government.Addressing the Congress Working Committee (CWC) meeting, Kharge said the party faced a “historic responsibility” to protect democracy and the Constitution, drawing a parallel between the Congress’ fight for voting rights during British rule and its current campaign over voter rolls.He alleged that names were being removed from electoral rolls “at the behest of the BJP and the Modi government” and accused the CEC of becoming a “puppet” of the government.On the contrary the Election Commission has maintained that its decisions have full legal sanction and that differing views among commissioners are part of institutional deliberations.Kharge also targeted changes to Form 6, which is used for enrolling new voters.He alleged that the rules had been changed in a way that could disenfranchise young voters. He also contrasted Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government with the decision of the Rajiv Gandhi government in 1988 to lower the voting age from 21 to 18.“They didn't provide jobs, and now they don't even want to give the right to vote,” Kharge said, alleging that the government feared questions from the youth.Also read: ‘All SIR rollout decisions unanimous’: EC says agendas for all meetings to be circulated in advance Kharge congratulated Rahul Gandhi for raising questions over voter rolls in Mahadevpuram, Aland and constituencies in Haryana and Maharashtra.He referred to allegations involving duplicate voters, doubtful addresses, multiple voters registered at the same address and entries linked to Form 6, saying the Election Commission should have acted on the issues.“If the Election Commission had shown even a little seriousness in that direction, they would not be in the dock today, and their credibility would have been preserved,” he said.Kharge also praised Congress workers who organised protests at the block, district and state levels following Rahul's campaign.The Congress has been pressing for Kumar's resignation amid a controversy over reported differences within the Election Commission over the SIR exercise. The poll panel has said that operational queries raised by Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi were part of normal institutional deliberations and that its orders followed established procedures.Kharge also questioned the decision-making process behind SIR, asking whether it was wrong to seek clarity on who approved the exercise and why the two election commissioners were allegedly kept out of the internal portal.Kharge laid out five demands that he said the Congress would pursue:He said the Congress did not view the issue merely as a contest over winning or losing elections, arguing that governments may change but democracy and the Constitution were permanent.Kharge also accused the BJP and RSS of systematically weakening independent institutions and said the Congress wanted the Election Commission to be strong enough to command the trust of both the ruling party and opposition.He alleged that two election commissioners had themselves described the CEC's actions as arbitrary and unfair and said those responsible should be removed.Kharge also demanded Prime Minister Narendra Modi's resignation “on moral grounds”, alleging that the CEC had acted under his pressure.The Congress president compared the current controversy with demonetisation, calling the alleged removal of voters from electoral rolls “vote demonetisation”.“In demonetisation, the poor stood in line. In vote demonetisation, the poor has been thrown out of the line altogether,” he said, arguing that voting was the biggest political tool available to poor, Dalit and marginalised citizens.The CWC meeting comes ahead of a meeting of opposition INDIA bloc parties on Wednesday, where a joint strategy on the SIR controversy and the demand for Kumar's removal is expected to be discussed. The opposition is also considering another removal notice against the CEC in Parliament.
Article Summary: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge accuses the Election Commission of compromising the integrity of the electoral process. He says names are being removed from electoral rolls “at the behest of the BJP and the Modi government’ Kharge also accuses the CEC of becoming a “puppet” of the government.

NEW DELHI: Telangana chief minister Revanth Reddy called "Shiva is the God of the poor, Ram is the God of the rich" while taking a dig at the BJP . Article Title: Will Pakistan decide J&K statehood, asks CM Omar
Article Text:
Jammu & Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

SRINAGAR: CM Omar Abdullah said Monday that making J&K statehood conditional on the end of militancy would effectively give Pakistan a say in its restoration, as the assembly passed a resolution for full statehood and set off a BJP walkout over its reference to a 2000 autonomy demand.Omar moved the resolution that calls on Union govt to restore full statehood. It refers to the 2000 assembly resolution accepting the state autonomy committee report and seeking greater autonomy, and a 2024 resolution seeking special status and constitutional guarantees for J&K.National Conference, Congress, PDP, Peoples Conference, Awami Ithaad Party and CPM supported it.BJP’s Sunil Sharma called the resolution “anti-constitutional” and “anti-secular”, saying its reference to the 2000 autonomy resolution amounted to seeking restoration of J&K’s “pre-1953 position”. BJP said it supports restoration of statehood but opposes the resolution in its current form. Its legislators entered the well, shouted “Vande Mataram” and “Bharat Mata Ki Jai” and moved a motion against speaker Abdul Rahim Rather.Omar criticised BJP’s opinion that statehood could be restored only after militancy ends. “Then the decision regarding restoration of the statehood will not be taken directly in New Delhi but it will be taken in Islamabad,” he said, adding if Pakistan is blamed for militancy, making restoration conditional on guns falling silent effectively gives Islamabad a say in when J&K gets statehood.“We are not begging,” Omar said. “We rightfully demand that we have the right to a statehood.”Omar said the resolution was rooted in a promise of restoring statehood and had nothing to do with Article 370, 35A or autonomy. J&K lost statehood and was bifurcated into two Union territories, including Ladakh, in Aug 2019 when Centre also scrapped its special constitutional status.The CM said he had deliberately kept Article 370, 35A and special status out of the resolution to prevent BJP from using them to disrupt proceedings. He also criticised NC members who had moved amendments seeking references to Article 370 and 35A, saying they had provided BJP “an excuse to oppose it”.Omar said Supreme Court had directed Centre to restore statehood “at the earliest” after assembly elections in 2024 and questioned whether two years could qualify as “as soon as possible”. Omar said there was still no clarity on when Centre considered the “right time” for restoration.Deputy CM Surinder Choudhary rejected BJP’s position that J&K’s sensitive location justified its UT status, saying nearly half of India’s states share borders with neighbouring countries.
Article Summary: Omar moved the resolution that calls on Union govt to restore full statehood. It refers to the 2000 assembly resolution accepting the state autonomy committee report. National Conference, Congress, PDP, Peoples Conference, Awami Ithaad Party and CPM supported it. BJP said it supports restoration of statehood but opposes the resolution in its current form.

Article Title: AAP donations fall 68%, BJD reports zero contributions
Article Text:
AAP’s donation inflow falls below one-third to Rs 12.1 crore in 2025-26

NEW DELHI: Aam Aadmi Party's receipts from contributions in 2025-26 fell to Rs 12.1 crore, which is less than one-third of its Rs 38.1 crore inflow through this route in 2024-25. Of this, Rs 10 crore, or 83% of its total donations, came from Prudent Electoral Trust and Trident Group founded by Rajya Sabha MP Rajendra Gupta, who switched loyalties from AAP to BJP earlier this year.AAP is the only party that declares all donation receipts and not just those above Rs 20,000 as required by the law. According to its latest contribution report filed with Election Commission (EC), both Prudent and Trident contributed Rs 5 crore each to AAP; in 2024-25, Prudent had donated Rs 16.4 crore to the party.Among regional parties, TDP, which is in office in Andhra Pradesh since 2024, declared its donation receipts at Rs 58.3 crore, though this is less than the Rs 83 crore contributions it had reported the previous year. Prudent contributed over 77% of TDP's total receipts through six donations in 2025-26. In 2024-25 too, Prudent was TDP's biggest donor, having contributed Rs 40 crore in all.YSR Congress Party, the main opposition party in Andhra Pradesh, received a total of Rs 24.3 crore in donations in 2025-26, though this figure is way less than its Rs 140 crore inflow in 2024-25.BRS, which was voted out of office by Congress in Telangana in 2023, declared its total contributions in 2025-26 at Rs 16.4 crore, up from Rs 15.1 crore in 2024-25. The 2025-26 contribution report for Biju Janata Dal (BJD), which was defeated in Odisha in 2024, records nil donations, as against Rs 60 crore declared in 2024-25.Part of AAP's donations in the last fiscal came from its MLAs, including former Delhi CMs Arvind Kejriwal (Rs 30,000) and Atishi Marlena (Rs 42,000).
Article Summary: Aam Aadmi Party's receipts from contributions in 2025-26 fell to Rs 12.1 crore. Of this, Rs 10 crore, or 83% of its total donations, came from Prudent Electoral Trust and Trident Group founded by Rajya Sabha MP Rajendra Gupta. TDP, which is in office in Andhra Pradesh since 2024, declared its donation receipts at Rs 58.3 crore.

Article Title: Collegium picks Delhi high court chief justice, 2 others as SC judges
Article Text:
Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: SC collegium Monday recommended to Union govt to appoint chief justices of Gujarat, Delhi and Telangana - Justices Sunita Agarwal, Devendra Kumar Upadhyay and Aparesh Kumar Singh - as judges of SC.The collegium comprising CJI Surya Kant, and Justices Vikram Nath, B V Nagarathna, M M Sundresh and P S Narasimha decided to recommend these three names.On acceptance of the recommendation and issuance of warrants of appointments, SC's working strength will increase to 37 judges against the sanctioned strength of 38. With Justice Agarwal's elevation, strength of women judges in SC would increase to two.As the parent high court of Justices Agarwal and Upadhyay is Allahabad HC, its representation in SC would increase to four. Justice Vikram Nath, who will be the next CJI in Feb, and Justice Manoj Mishra also started their judicial careers from Allahabad HC.Justice Agarwal and Justice Upadhyay were appointed judges of Allahabad HC in Nov 2011 while Justice Singh was appointed judge of Jharkhand HC in Jan 2012. Justice Agarwal became CJ of Gujarat HC in July 2023.Justice Upadhyay was appointed CJ of Bombay HC on July 29, 2023 and then CJ of Delhi HC on Jan 21, 2025. He held the first inquiry on discovery of burnt cash at Justice Yashwant Varma's residence in March last year.Justice Singh was appointed Chief Justice of Tripura high court in April 2023 and then appointed CJ of Telangana in July 2025.
Article Summary: Justices Sunita Agarwal, Devendra Kumar Upadhyay and Aparesh Kumar Singh recommended to Union govt to appoint chief justices of Gujarat, Delhi and Telangana. On acceptance of the recommendation, SC's working strength will increase to 37 judges against sanctioned strength of 38.

Article Title: 12 BJP CMs defend EC amid SIR row, hit back at Rahul Gandhi after poll body's fresh note
Article Text:
BJP CMs Rekha Gupta, Devendra Fadnavis and Yogi Adityanath

What BJP CMs said

Rahul Gandhi’s cryptic post

The controversy

NEW DELHI: A dozen BJP chief ministers held press conferences in their respective states on Sunday, a day after the Election Commission of India (ECI) issued a press release responding to a media report that had claimed a “rift” between Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar and the two Election Commissioners, Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi.According to a statement issued by the ruling party, the chief ministers accused Congress MP Rahul Gandhi and his party-led opposition INDIA bloc of “conspiring to defame constitutional institutions."In states where the BJP or its NDA allies are not in power, state BJP presidents or leaders of the opposition from the saffron party addressed media instead.Maharashtra chief minister Devendra Fadnavis remarked that "no vote was stolen, Rahul Gandhi's mind was stolen." He accused the Lok Sabha leader of opposition of "seeking to spread anarchy by defaming institutions" while claiming to defend the Constitution.Uttar Pradesh chief minister Yogi Adityanath accused the opposition parties of creating "confusion" over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. In Assam, Himanta Biswa Sarma described the INDIA bloc as an “alliance of losers,” while Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary argued that "cleansing" the voter list was necessary because “booth capturing no longer works in the country.”West Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari pointed to the Congress’s support for the SIR in Keralam, where it won, and its opposition to the exercise in Bengal after losing the election.Uttarakhand chief minister Pushkar Singh Dhami objected to what he described as an "attempt to defame institutions by presenting a note from an internal discussion as a final decision.”Rajasthan chief minister Bhajan Lal Sharma questioned why the Congress had not "verified the facts" before making serious allegations over the June 24, 2025, orders concerning the nationwide SIR, which he maintained were adopted by the ECI full consensus of the CEC and the election commissioners.Chhattisgarh's Vishnu Deo Sai accused the Congress of resorting to “anti-national” conduct after “having lost more than 100 elections.” Referring to the Election Commissioners’ joint statement, accompanied by a photograph of the three officials seated at a table, Sai argued that it had exposed what he called a “conspiracy to tarnish the country’s image.”Delhi chief minister Rekha Gupta, where a third of the electorate was removed and a third of those remaining received notices as part of the ongoing revision, framed the Opposition’s position on the issue as an attempt to “divert attention from its failures."Rahul Gandhi, meanwhile, posted cryptically on X: “I love swimming in the sea when it’s rough. It teaches you that rough is just another kind of calm.”At a press conference on September 24, a day after The Indian Express published its report, the Congress leader claimed his “vote chori” (vote theft) allegation stood “vindicated.” The Raebareli MP also demanded that CEC Gyanesh Kumar resign or be removed, accusing him of “treason.”The Indian Express reported on September 23 that Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had objected to at least 14 decisions over 10 months concerning the ongoing SIR exercise and related matters.The ECI has not disputed that objections were raised; however it characterised them as "disagreements" that were subsequently resolved, stressing that the final decisions were "unanimous." While Sandhu and Joshi are yet to speak to the media, the poll panel's press note second statement outlined several measures and clarifications.The BJP has maintained that the ECI’s press notes have “settled the matter”. Its allies, who, like the opposition, had sought an explanation from the poll body, also welcomed the commission's statement.
Article Summary: A dozen BJP chief ministers held press conferences in their respective states on Sunday. The chief ministers accused Congress MP Rahul Gandhi and his party-led opposition INDIA bloc of “conspiring to defame constitutional institutions” In states where the BJP or its NDA allies are not in power, state BJP presidents or leaders of the opposition from the saffron party addressed media instead.

Article Title: ‘Wait and face criticism’: Audio clip of Ashok Chavan fuels row over Mudkhed, Mukhed exclusion from drought list
Article Text:
​Rajya Sabha member Ashok Chavan (second from right) along with his daughter and Bhokar BJP MLA Sreejaya on Monday submitted a memorandum to revenue minister Chandrashekhar Bawankule, regarding inclusion of Mudkhed and Mukhed talukas in the list of drought-affected talukas

​Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar:





An alleged audio call between BJP MP Ashok Chavan and a party worker has gone viral, escalating the political row over Mudkhed and Mukhed talukas being left out of state govt’s drought-relief list.In the audio clip, a party worker was allegedly heard confronting former CM Chavan over the omission of Mudkhed from the drought list, saying residents were angry and demanding answers. In the clip, the worker reportedly told Chavan that BJP cadre were facing sharp criticism from farmers and citizens who believed the region was facing drought-like conditions despite being left out of the notified list.Responding to the concerns, Chavan could be heard urging restraint, saying less than 24 hours had elapsed since govt’s announcement. He allegedly advised the worker against launching protests and assured him that Mudkhed would eventually be included in the drought list.At one stage, Chavan was purportedly heard telling the worker to “remain calm and face the criticism”, while asking party workers to trust the process and wait for further developments. The worker, however, continued to question why Mudkhed and Mukhed were excluded when almost the entire state, including most of Marathwada, received drought recognition.The audio has rapidly circulated across social media platforms, amplifying discontent among farmers and residents of the two Nanded district talukas.The controversy stems from Maharashtra govt’s decision to declare drought-like conditions in 265 of the state’s 358 talukas following deficient rainfall. In Marathwada, 74 of 76 talukas were included, with Mukhed and Mudkhed emerging as the only exceptions.The issue carries added political significance as Mudkhed tehsil falls within Bhokar assembly constituency, represented by Chavan’s daughter and first-time BJP MLA Sreejaya Chavan. Mukhed assembly constituency is represented by BJP MLA Tushar Rathod, who is serving his third consecutive term.Officials have maintained that both talukas had failed to meet the trigger-I criteria under the state’s drought assessment framework. Nanded collector Rahul Kardile, however, said Mudkhed and Mukhed would be reassessed under the next evaluation trigger scheduled for early Oct.Chavan has separately sought the inclusion of both talukas, arguing that technical rainfall data does not adequately capture the extent of crop losses caused by prolonged dry spells. He has maintained that ground realities and agricultural damage in the two regions warrant their inclusion in the drought-relief list.
Article Summary: Mudkhed and Mukhed talukas were left out of state govt’s drought-relief list. An alleged audio call between BJP MP Ashok Chavan and a party worker has gone viral. The audio has rapidly circulated across social media platforms.

Article Title: Farmer dies after consuming poison; wife alleges harassment over Rs 9 lakh loan; abetment case against moneylender
Article Text:
Kolhapur

:





A Rs 9 lakh loan cost a Kolhapur farmer Rs 25 lakh, and ultimately, his life, his wife said, accusing a private moneylender of harassment. Police have booked the private moneylender for abetment to suicide, though his whereabouts are currently unknown.Police said 48-year-old Shridhar Davare, a resident of Sonage village in Kagal, died on Saturday after allegedly consuming weedicide on Sept 23. Police found two notes in Davare’s pockets, which are suspected to be dying declarations. In a text message to his wife, Savita, before taking the extreme step, Davare asked her to look after their son, she told police.Davare was first taken to a private hospital in Nipani. As his condition deteriorated, he was shifted to CPR Hospital in Kolhapur, where he died on Saturday.Following his death, Savita lodged a complaint against the private moneylender. She alleged that her husband had borrowed Rs 9 lakh from him and repaid a total of Rs 25 lakh over the past five years. Despite this, she alleged, the lender continued demanding more money, claiming that the loan and interest had not been fully repaid. She also accused him of harassing and physically assaulting Davare over the dues.Police have registered a case under BNS sections 108, 115(2) and 351(1), along with sections 39 and 45 of the Maharashtra Money-Lending (Regulation) Act, 2014.
Article Summary: Shridhar Davare, 48, died on Saturday after allegedly consuming weedicide. Police found two notes in Davare’s pockets, which are suspected to be dying declarations. Police have booked the private moneylender for abetment to suicide, though his whereabouts are currently unknown.

NAVI MUMBAI: In a hit-and-run incident on the Thane-Belapur Road, a police constable and a woman assistant sub-inspector (ASI) were injured when a speeding MUV rammed into their motorcycle from behind while they were patrolling during the seventh day of Ganpati immersion.The incident took place near Digha pond on the Belapur-bound lane at around 12.20am on Monday.The injured cops were identified as constable Umesh Patil, 41, who was riding his personal motorcycle, and ASI Rashmin Magar, who was riding pillion.The motorcycle skidded after being hit by the MUV. Patil sustained injuries to his left leg, while Magar suffered bruises to her left elbow, shoulder and left leg.Acting on a complaint filed by Patil, Rabale MIDC police registered an FIR under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and the Motor Vehicles Act against the MUV driver. Police traced him to his residence in Ghansoli.Devidas Kathale, senior inspector of Rabale MIDC police, said, “As the accused MUV driver's wife is due to deliver in a few days, he will be summoned to the police station later and served with a notice under the provisions of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita.”
Article Summary: The incident took place near Digha pond on the Belapur-bound lane at around 12.20am on Monday. The injured cops were identified as constable Umesh Patil, 41, and ASI Rashmin Magar, who was riding pillion. The motorcycle skidded after being hit by the MUV.

Article Title: Speeding SUV hits bike in Vashi, 3 youths injured; driver traced
Article Text:
Accused driver of SUV Mahindra Thar escaping after accident





NAVI MUMBAI: Three youths riding a bike were injured after a speeding SUV allegedly hit them head-on near PKC Hospital in Sector 14, Vashi, in the early hours of Monday.The incident took place around 1am. The injured youths were initially taken to NMMC Hospital in Vashi and were later referred to Sion Hospital for further treatment.Following the incident, a biker passing through the area chased the SUV and recorded its registration number on his mobile phone. Police then traced the vehicle's owner and obtained his mobile number.During the investigation, it was learnt that the owner's younger brother had taken the SUV out for a joy ride. Police subsequently traced his mobile tower location to an area near the creek in Sector 12, Vashi, where he was allegedly hiding.He was detained and served a notice under the provisions of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), following which he was released.
Article Summary: Three youths riding a bike were injured after a speeding SUV allegedly hit them head-on near PKC Hospital in Sector 14, Vashi, in the early hours of Monday. A biker passing through the area chased the SUV and recorded its registration number on his mobile phone. Police traced the vehicle's owner and obtained his mobile number. The owner's younger brother had taken the SUV out for a joy ride.

Article Title: Disha Salian case: Father, lawyer seek police protection, allege threats from Sena (UBT) leaders
Article Text:
Ojha questioned Aaditya Thackeray’s ‘Y-plus’ security, saying those who raised the issue and allegedly faced threats remained unprotected.

(With agency inputs)





THANE: Advocate Nilesh Ojha on Sunday said that Disha Salian’s father, Satish Salian, Sameer Wankhede, Ashutosh Pathak and he have sought police protection, alleging that they received threats from Shiv Sena (UBT) leaders.Ojha, who is representing Satish Salian in the case, said they have written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union home minister Amit Shah, the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), the Chief Justice of India and Maharashtra chief minister Devendra Fadnavis, seeking protection."The CBI FIR was registered, and a letter was immediately written requesting police protection for four individuals: Satish Salian, our witness Sameer Wankhede, myself, and Ashutosh Pathak, " Ojha told news agency ANI.Ojha questioned the provision of ‘Y-plus’ security to Aaditya Thackeray , saying those who brought the matter to light and allegedly faced threats had been left without protection."The letter clearly states, citing records from your Home Ministry and the Narcotics Bureau, that it is evident that Aditya Thackeray is involved in the drug trade. Furthermore, an FIR has now been registered against him regarding gang rape, murder, and a cover-up.Several other high-profile individuals and police officers are also implicated as accused in this matter," he said."We have already provided all prima facie evidence; the CBI has obtained everything necessary during the investigation to secure a conviction. Yet, the accused currently enjoys 'Y-plus' security provided by your administration. Meanwhile, those who brought this matter to light and those facing direct threats from individuals like Sanjay Raut were left unprotected," the advocate added.He further said that providing security was mandatory under the Witness Protection Scheme and Supreme Court guidelines, and alleged that their request for protection had not been acted upon.He further added, "Providing security is mandatory under the Witness Protection Scheme and Supreme Court guidelines. Yet, they failed to do so. Consequently, we compiled all the material and handed it over to the CBI. We also urged them to investigate the role of Police Commissioner Deven Bharti and determine why police protection was not granted.""We have given a copy of this to the CBI, along with Prime Minister Modi ji, the Home Minister, the Chief Justice of India, and the Chief Minister," Ojha said.Disha Salian was found dead in Mumbai on June 8, 2020. Her death was initially registered as an Accidental Death Report (ADR).Salian died days before actor Sushant Singh Rajput , whose death also led to a high-profile investigation and widespread public controversy.Bombay High Court directed the CBI to register a formal First Information Report (FIR) and launch a fresh probe.As the probe progresses, Satish Salian, accompanied by his lawyer Nilesh Ojha, has submitted a pen drive containing material they described as evidence related to Disha Salian’s death.Meanwhile, Aaditya Thackeray has denied the allegations and responded to the defamation notice issued by Satish Salian.
Article Summary: Disha Salian’s father, Satish Salian, Sameer Wankhede, Ashutosh Pathak and he have sought police protection. They allege that they received threats from Shiv Sena (UBT) leaders. Ojha questioned the provision of ‘Y-plus’ security to Aaditya Thackeray. He said those who raised the issue and allegedly faced threats remained unprotected.

Article Title: PM classmate’s battle for land continues despite BJP MLA's exit, no possession yet
Article Text:
Asgar Ali Vora met the PM on Sept 8 and sought his intervention in the land disp­u­te





BHAYANDAR: Asgar Ali Vora, a schoolmate of Prime Minister Narendra Modi , continues to struggle to regain possession of his land after MLA Narendra Mehta’s company announced that it had relinquished the property. However, another developer is allegedly continuing to retain possession of the land.Vora, 81, had purchased around 2,810 sq m of land at Navghar in Bhayandar East in 1989. He has alleged that Swayam Builders and Mehta’s Seven Eleven Constructions took possession of the property in 2011. After pursuing the matter for nearly 15 years, Vora met PM Modi on Sep 8 and complained against Mehta.Following the meeting, Mehta relinquished possession of the land, while the municipal corporation also cancelled the construction permission granted to him.However, the land has allegedly not been handed back to its original owner. Instead, developers Mukesh Parekh and Mervyn Fernandes are allegedly continuing to retain possession of the property. Following a complaint by Shiv Sena, Navghar police have registered a non-cognisable offence against Seven Eleven Constructions, Parekh and Fernandes.
Article Summary: Asgar Ali Vora, 81, had purchased around 2,810 sq m of land at Navghar in Bhayandar East in 1989. He has alleged that Swayam Builders and Mehta’s Seven Eleven Constructions took possession of the property in 2011. After pursuing the matter for nearly 15 years, Vora met PM Modi on Sep 8 and complained.

Article Title: Student dies, friend injured after motorcycle hits vehicle in Bavdhan
Article Text:
Chougule was declared dead by doctors. His friend Yashraj More is currently undergoing treatment

Pune:





An 18-year-old student died and his friend was severely injured after their motorcycle rammed into a vehicle on the Katraj-Dehu Road bypass at Bavdhan on Friday.Bavdhan police sub-inspector Shrirang Thakare said, “On Thursday night, the two friends had gone to Hinjewadi on the deceased’s 650cc motorcycle. Around 3.30am on Friday, they were returning home when the bike hit the vehicle, lost control, and both riders skidded for some distance. ”The deceased, Sarvadnya Chougule from Kolhapur, was pursuing engineering from a private college in Pune and stayed in Bibvewadi, police said. When taken to a nearby hospital, Chougule was declared dead by doctors. His friend Yashraj More is currently undergoing treatment.“We have registered a case of causing death by negligence. Our investigation is on,” Thakare said.
Article Summary: Sarvadnya Chougule from Kolhapur, was pursuing engineering from a private college in Pune and stayed in Bibvewadi. His friend Yashraj More is currently undergoing treatment. Police have registered a case of causing death by negligence.

Article Title: Two held with 189kg gutka, 500g ganja in Coimbatore
Article Text:
The seizure was made during a vehicle check in Vadavalli on Sunday

Coimbatore:





City police seized 189kg of gutka products and 500g of ganja from a taxi during a vehicle check near Vadavalli on Sunday and arrested two men in connection with the seizure. Police also seized the car in which the contraband was found.The arrested have been identified as B Andrews, 41, of Madukkarai, and R Selva, 28, from Sivaganga district. They were apprehended when police conducted a vehicle check following a tip-off.The two were subsequently produced before a court and remanded in judicial custody. Police are investigating the source of the contraband and the intended recipients as part of the probe.
Article Summary: City police seized 189kg of gutka products and 500g of ganja from a taxi during a vehicle check near Vadavalli. Police also seized the car in which the contraband was found. The arrested have been identified as B Andrews, 41, of Madukkarai, and R Selva, 28, from Sivaganga district.

Article Title: Man, aides booked for assaulting dalit man over tank dispute
Article Text:
Alanganallur police have registered a case under SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act against a man and his associates for allegedly assaulting and hurling casteist slurs at a 46-year-old dalit labourer





Madurai: Alanganallur police have registered a case under SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act against a man and his associates for allegedly assaulting and hurling casteist slurs at a 46-year-old dalit labourer, who questioned illegal fishing and water channel encroachments in Podumbu village. This follows a direction from Madras high court asking police to act, based on a petition from Pon Marimuthu, 46, a resident of Gandhiji Nagar Colony Street in Podumbu.According to the FIR, on May 6 when PWD officials inspected the spot, Marimuthu objected to unauthorised leasing of fishing rights in two local tanks which allegedly fetched up to ₹15 lakh illicitly. He alerted PWD officials regarding water drainage and blocking of inlet channels leading to the local water bodies.Irked by this, the suspect, identified as Kumar, and his associates reportedly confronted him at a local farm garden. Marimuthu alleged that they attacked him, grabbed him by the neck, hurled caste-based abuse, and attempted to tie him up inside the farm.Alanganallur police registered an FIR on Sept 24 against Kumar and unidentified fishing leaseholders under relevant sections of BNS, along with sections of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act. Further investigation is underway.
Article Summary: Alanganallur police have registered a case under SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act against a man and his associates for allegedly assaulting and hurling casteist slurs at a 46-year-old dalit labourer. This follows a direction from Madras high court asking police to act, based on a petition from Pon Marimuthu.

Article Title: Man booked for defamatory remarks against Madurai MP
Article Text:
City police on Saturday booked a man on charges of posting derogatory remarks against Madurai MP Su Venkatesan on social media.





Madurai: City police on Saturday booked a man on charges of posting derogatory remarks against Madurai MP Su Venkatesan on social media.SS Colony police registered the case based on a complaint lodged by Ganesan, secretary of the CPM’s Madurai city district committee.Police said Sivaprabakaran of Madurai posted a video clip against the MP on social media on Sept 23.The complainant alleged that Sivaprabakaran made remarks intended to create religious disharmony and made derogatory statements concerning Meenakshi Sundareshwarar Temple.Police registered a case under sections 196(1)(a) (promoting enmity between groups), 352 (intentional insult provoking breach of peace) and 353(2) (spreading false information or rumours promoting enmity between groups) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Further investigation is on.
Article Summary: City police on Saturday booked a man on charges of posting derogatory remarks against Madurai MP Su Venkatesan on social media. Sivaprabakaran of Madurai posted a video clip against the MP on Sept 23. Police registered a case under sections 196(1)(a) (promoting enmity between groups), 352 (intentional insult provoking breach of peace) and 353(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.

Article Title: Awareness event held on vanishing indigenous sheep
Article Text:
At an awareness meeting held in Kadayakkulam village, Ramanathapuram District, the Tamil Nadu Federation of Pastoral People’s Sangam highlighted the urgent need to conserve the endangered Ramnad White Sheep, a traditional indigenous breed once native to the Ramanathapuram region





Madurai: An awareness meeting for pastoralists was held at Kadayakkulam village, Ramanathapuram district, highlighting the alarming decline of the native Ramnad White sheep, a breed once widely distributed across the state.Local pastoralists and conservationists from the Tamil Nadu Federation of Pastoral People’s Sangam (TFPPS) gathered to honour Thirupathi, a traditional pastoral farmer from the village, for his dedicated efforts in preserving the indigenous livestock breed.Thirupathi was presented with the Best Livestock Breed Conservator Award, instituted by the ICAR-National Bureau of Animal Genetic Resources (NBAGR), which he was unable to collect during a ceremony in Delhi earlier this year. Rajiv Gandhi , TFPPS president, warned that the purebred Ramnad White sheep is currently on the brink of extinction. “Over the past three decades, some pastoralists mixed local flocks with larger Nellore sheep from Andhra Pradesh, which drastically diluted the native genetic pool. Today, official census figures fail to reflect ground realities, where purebred herds have virtually vanished,” he said. Local estimates suggest that only hundreds of purebred Ramnad White sheep are in existence across the state.“Preserving indigenous sheep breeds such as the Ramnad White and the critically endangered Katchaikatty is deeply tied to regional culture and livelihoods,” Gandhi said, calling for govt intervention and dedicated schemes to safeguard these livestock.
Article Summary: An awareness meeting for pastoralists was held at Kadayakkulam village, Ramanathapuram district. It highlighted the alarming decline of the native Ramnad White sheep, a breed once widely distributed across the state. Local estimates suggest that only hundreds of purebred Ramnads are in existence.

Article Title: Bail for job fraud accused
Article Text:
Kochi

:

Man held for theft:





Parvathy Maya Shaji, accused of alleged job fraud, was granted bail on Monday.City Police had registered three cases against Shaji, who runs Amster Overseas. Shaji was arrested by Palarivattom Police on Thursday at Thiruvananthapuram airport as she arrived from abroad.Three youths hailing from Erumapetty in Thrissur, Ponnani in Malappuram and Mamala in Ernakulam had filed complaints against her earlier. They had alleged that they were cheated after being promised jobs in Armenia and Poland. The police sources said that they have received information that efforts were on by the parties involved to settle the matter. She has secured bail in all cases, said the police.Kalamassery Police arrested a Thiruvankulam native for alleged bike theft. He was arrested during a vehicle inspection on Monday.During preliminary questioning, he admitted that the vehicle in which he was travelling had been stolen from the premises of Alappuzha Medical College. During a detailed interrogation that followed, he also revealed that he had stolen and concealed another vehicle from the premises of Kottayam Medical College. Based on the information provided by him, the police recovered the vehicle. The police said that the man reportedly had multiple cases against him and he will be handed over to Alappuzha Police for further investigation.
Article Summary: Parvathy Maya Shaji, accused of alleged job fraud, was granted bail on Monday. Shaji was arrested by Palarivattom Police on Thursday at Thiruvananthapuram airport. Three youths hailing from Thrissur, Ponnani and Mamala had filed complaints against her earlier.

Article Title: Kerala HC seeks report on additional Posco courts required in state
Article Text:
The bench further directed that the affidavit filed by the registry should indicate the courts trying Pocso cases that do not conform to the guidelines

Kochi

:





The high court has sought a detailed affidavit from the registrar of the district judiciary regarding the number of additional courts required for trying Pocso cases in the state.A bench of Chief Justice Soumen Sen and Justice V M Syam Kumar issued the directive while considering a PIL filed by the District Court Bar Association, Thodupuzha-Muttom, highlighting the need for adequate facilities in Pocso special courts in Keralam. While considering the PIL, the bench observed that during its visits to the district courts, it was found that most Pocso courts did not conform to the guidelines specified under the Pocso Act and that the facilities were also inadequate.The bench further directed that the affidavit filed by the registry should indicate the courts trying Pocso cases that do not conform to the guidelines. It also directed that immediate steps be taken to ensure that such courts conform to the guidelines. If there is any inadequacy of space, the state govt shall take steps to provide suitable rooms with the necessary infrastructure for the functioning of Pocso courts in conformity with the guidelines, the bench ordered.The petitioners further pointed out that the appointment of exclusive public prosecutors for Pocso courts is mandatory and alleged that the state had failed to fulfil this obligation. They also referred to Supreme Court decision which requested the Chief Justices of all high courts to ensure that special programmes are developed at the state judicial academies to impart training to special public prosecutors attached to Pocso courts not only in law but also in child psychology, child behaviour and health issues.Based on the submissions made by the petitioners, the court directed the director general of prosecution to file an affidavit regarding the appointment and training of public prosecutors for Pocso courts and adjourned the PIL to Oct 14.
Article Summary: The high court has sought a detailed affidavit from the registrar of the district judiciary regarding the number of additional courts required for trying Pocso cases in the state. A bench of Chief Justice Soumen Sen and Justice V M Syam Kumar issued the directive while considering a PIL filed by the District Court Bar Association, Thodupuzha-Muttom.

Article Title: Case against five over cyberattack on K C Venugopal
Article Text:
AICC general secretary K C Venugopal

Kottayam

:





Alappuzha Cyber Police have registered a case against five persons, all identified as Congress sympathisers, in connection with a cyberattack targeting AICC general secretary K C Venugopal, police said. The case follows a complaint filed two months ago by Congress’s Johnson Abraham directly with the DGP, listing details of five social media accounts.Police said the social media profiles of two of the individuals had photographs with chief minister V D Satheesan. Cases have been registered against Siju Samuel, K P Hamsa, Jafar K Aliyar Kattikunnath, Abdulkhader Reshi and P C Pulamanthol under the Information Technology Act and other relevant provisions, police said.The attacks on Venugopal are reported to have intensified during a controversy involving the selection of chief minister that followed the election results, though police have not detailed the specific content of the posts.
Article Summary: Alappuzha Cyber Police have registered a case against five persons in connection with a cyberattack targeting AICC general secretary K C Venugopal. The case follows a complaint filed two months ago by Congress’s Johnson Abraham directly with the DGP, listing details of five social media accounts.

Article Title: Exam ‘irregularities’: Kerala HC tells its registry to place PSC’s plea before single bench
Article Text:
An HC bench issued the directive while allowing an appeal filed by the PSC challenging a single bench order upholding the objection raised by the HC registry

Kochi:





A high court division bench has directed the HC registry to number a petition filed by the Kerala Public Service Commission (PSC) seeking to quash the criminal case registered against its members and staff over alleged exam irregularities and place it before a single bench.A bench of Justices K Natarajan and Johnson John issued the directive while allowing an appeal filed by the PSC challenging a single bench order upholding the objection raised by the HC registry. The division bench also clarified that the single bench would consider both the maintainability and merits of the petition.The PSC had filed the petition in a case arising from allegations regarding the conduct and evaluation of an exam held for appointment to the post of chief (industry and infrastructure division) in the PSC.According to the PSC, the exam was conducted in July 2023, and Arun J Prathap secured the first rank and was advised for appointment in June 2025. Later, following litigation initiated by a rank holder before the Kerala Administrative Tribunal, it was revealed that answers to 10 questions in the written examination had not been evaluated.Accordingly, the state govt on July 8 granted prosecution sanction under Section 17A of the PC Act to prosecute members and staff of the commission in the matter.Subsequently, the crime branch registered a case on July 29 against PSC members and staff, prompting them to approach the HC.The HC registry, however, did not accept the petition, raising objections over certain defects, including its filing as a writ petition (criminal) instead of a Cr MC under the provisions of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023. When the matter was considered by the single bench, it upheld the objection. The PSC subsequently filed an appeal challenging the single bench order.
Article Summary: HC bench issued the directive while allowing an appeal filed by the PSC challenging a single bench order upholding the objection raised by the HC registry. The division bench also clarified that the single bench would consider both the maintainability and merits of the petition. The PSC had filed the petition in a case arising from allegations regarding the conduct and evaluation of an exam held for appointment.

Article Title: ‘Defamatory’ video: Actor Lakshmipriya moves Kerala HC to quash case against her
Article Text:
Malayalam film actor Lakshmipriya

Kochi

:





Malayalam film actor Lakshmipriya has approached the high court seeking to quash the proceedings in a case registered against her on a complaint by fellow actor Ansiba Hassan , alleging that she and two others circulated videos on social media containing sexually coloured remarks against her.A bench of Justice Jobin Sebastian on Monday directed the petitioner to issue notice to Hassan and adjourned the matter to Oct 22. While considering the petition, the bench orally remarked that disputes among members of the actors’ association AMMA had reached a stage where a special court might be required to resolve them. Earlier, the same bench had directed the judicial first-class magistrate court, Ernakulam, to reconsider Hassan’s complaint against Lakshmipriya and others after setting aside the magistrate court’s order declining her plea to register a case. Following reconsideration, the magistrate court directed the police to register a case against Lakshmipriya and others, prompting her to approach the HC.Hassan, a former office-bearer of the Association of Malayalam Movie Artists (AMMA) alleged that the videos were aimed at tarnishing her image and subjecting her to public humiliation. Her complaint to the police had earlier been declined on the ground that it did not disclose any cognizable offence and, at most, constituted an offence of defamation.
Article Summary: Malayalam film actor Lakshmipriya has approached the high court seeking to quash the proceedings in a case registered against her. A bench of Justice Jobin Sebastian on Monday directed the petitioner to issue notice to Hassan and adjourned the matter to Oct 22. The bench orally remarked that disputes among members of the actors’ association AMMA had reached a stage where a special court might be required to resolve them.
